name: Praesidium Potion
summary: A remedy that shields the drinker from a vampire's fangs.
effect: Immunity to neck snaps and vampire bites.
duration: 20 min with a [[blood-cup]] · 40 min with a [[blood-dish]]
steps: Have a vampire fill a cup or dish with blood.
Combine it with a verbena flower at the cauldron.
Say “Praesidium!” in chat when you use it.
notes: The old handbook says it protects the witch who drinks it.
